boards.title: Claimed by 9am: 10 Study Spots Worth Showing Up Early For
boards.description: Ten distinct library study environments available to current Claremont Colleges students, including Scripps students.

cards.title: Ella Strong Denison Library
cards.subtitle: Scripps College · 1030 Columbia Avenue
cards.notes: Bring your Claremont Colleges ID and settle in with reading or research; use the library’s current hours page before planning a visit.
cards.short_summary: A Scripps special-collections library that is open to current Claremont Colleges students for study space.
cards.evidence_claim: Denison Library is open to current students, faculty, and staff of The Claremont Colleges to use for study space; campus ID is required on arrival.
cards.access_notes: Current students, faculty, and staff of The Claremont Colleges may use study space; bring a Claremont Colleges campus ID. Check the library page for current hours.

cards.title: Holbein Room
cards.subtitle: Ella Strong Denison Library · Scripps College
cards.notes: Choose this room for quiet reading or research, and keep the visit flexible because the library also uses it for meetings and events.
cards.short_summary: A named Denison Library study and research room with a Gothic fireplace.
cards.evidence_claim: Denison Library identifies the Holbein Room, with its Gothic fireplace, as one of its comfortable and quiet spaces for study and research.
cards.source_title: History of Denison Library | Scripps College
cards.access_notes: Inside Denison Library. The room can also host meetings or special events; confirm building access and room availability before going.

cards.title: Ellen Browning Scripps Room
cards.subtitle: Ella Strong Denison Library · Scripps College
cards.notes: Use the smaller room for a focused research block, after confirming library access and whether a library activity is using the space.
cards.short_summary: A smaller named quiet study and research room in Denison Library.
cards.evidence_claim: Denison Library lists the smaller Ellen Browning Scripps Room among its comfortable and quiet spaces for study and research.
cards.source_title: History of Denison Library | Scripps College
cards.access_notes: Inside Denison Library; follow the library’s current campus-ID access policy and check availability before visiting.

cards.title: Collaborative Commons
cards.subtitle: Honnold 2 North · The Claremont Colleges Library
cards.notes: Bring a laptop and charger for an open-table work session; use the modular seating and charging bar when you need to shift between solo and shared work.
cards.short_summary: An open study area with modular seating, pivot-table chairs, media:scape tables, and device charging.
cards.evidence_claim: The Collaborative Commons on Honnold 2 North is an open study area with modular seating, pivot-table chairs, media:scape tables, and a Power Bar for charging devices.
cards.access_notes: Located inside The Claremont Colleges Library. Consult current building policies and access information before visiting.

cards.title: Study Cubes
cards.subtitle: Mudd 2 North & South · The Claremont Colleges Library
cards.notes: Pick a semi-private cube for independent work or a small collaboration; no reservation is required according to the library’s space guide.
cards.short_summary: Semi-private study cubes for individual or group work with no reservation requirement listed.
cards.evidence_claim: The Claremont Colleges Library lists semi-private Study Cubes for individual or group study in Mudd 2 North and South, with no reservation required.
cards.access_notes: No reservation is required per the library’s space guide; check current building access policies before visiting.

cards.title: Digital Scholarship Collaboratory
cards.subtitle: Mudd 2 South · The Claremont Colleges Library
cards.notes: Use this open area when your assignment benefits from dual monitors, specialized software, or data visualization tools; check workstation availability on arrival.
cards.short_summary: An open study area equipped with high-performance digital research and visualization tools.
cards.evidence_claim: The Digital Scholarship Collaboratory in Mudd 2 South is an open study area with dual monitors, a data-visualization panel, and software suites.
cards.access_notes: Located inside The Claremont Colleges Library; verify current building access and workstation availability before visiting.

cards.title: Quiet Study Spaces
cards.subtitle: Honnold 4 North & South · The Claremont Colleges Library
cards.notes: Head to the fourth floor for reading or writing that needs minimal distraction, using the open tables and modular seating.
cards.short_summary: Fourth-floor quiet areas designed around open seating and minimal noise distraction.
cards.evidence_claim: Quiet Study Spaces in Honnold 4 North and South provide ample open seating with modular tables and minimal noise distraction.
cards.access_notes: Located inside The Claremont Colleges Library; consult current building policies and access information before visiting.

cards.title: Meditation Space
cards.subtitle: Honnold 4 · The Claremont Colleges Library
cards.notes: Use this quiet, inclusive room for a reflective break before returning to coursework; respect its stated use for reflection, prayer, and contemplation.
cards.short_summary: A fourth-floor quiet environment for reflection, prayer, and contemplation.
cards.evidence_claim: The Claremont Colleges Library’s Meditation Space on Honnold 4 is a quiet and inclusive environment for reflection, prayer, and contemplation.
cards.access_notes: Located inside The Claremont Colleges Library; use it consistently with its reflective purpose and check current building access policies.

cards.entity_name: Open Study Area + Government Docs and Microfilm
cards.title: Open Study Area + Government Docs and Microfilm
cards.subtitle: Mudd 1 · The Claremont Colleges Library
cards.notes: Set up in this open area when your research may need maps, government documents, microfilm, or nearby print collections.
cards.short_summary: An open study area adjacent to government documents, maps, microfilm, and print books.
cards.evidence_claim: Mudd 1 includes an open study space alongside government documents, maps, microfilm, and print book collections.
cards.access_notes: Located inside The Claremont Colleges Library; check current building policies and access information before visiting.

cards.title: Study Room 406
cards.subtitle: Honnold 4 · The Claremont Colleges Library
cards.notes: Reserve this enclosed group room when your team needs whiteboards and a projector, then arrive ready to work within the booked time.
cards.short_summary: An enclosed fourth-floor group-study room with whiteboards and a short-throw projector.
cards.evidence_claim: Study Room 406 is an enclosed group-study room on Honnold 4 with whiteboards and a short-throw projector.
cards.access_notes: Study rooms are reservable for current students, faculty, and staff; review the library’s current reservation process and room rules before going.
